headline: Doable but full: 4 places in 10 nights, about 2.5 nights each.
findings:
Costs you

4 places to sleep in 10 nights is 3 hotel moves — about 2.5 nights per place; three or more is where a stay stops being mostly arriving and leaving.

Costs you

Sapporo gets 1 night; a place like this needs about 2 to be more than a check-in and a check-out.

Costs you

Osaka → Sapporo: 1059 km in a straight line, so this is a flight — about 4 h 35 min door to door (estimate). Sidequest doesn’t estimate an overland journey this long; a train or ferry may exist, but it would take most of a day or a night.

Worth knowing

Changing beds costs about 1.4 of your 11 days (13%) — 9 h 35 min of travel plus about 1 h 30 min each time to check out, get going and check in (estimate).
